entries.title: Letter No. 937 — response to two letters and two panim; positive thought and speech regarding illness
entries.summary: Published correspondence page identifies the recipient as R. Yisrael Noach Bilenitzky and states that the letter responds to two undated letters and two enclosed panim. The response includes assurance that the panim will be read at the Rebbe Rayatz's gravesite and guidance against severe/exaggerated speech about illness, explicitly invoking 'Tracht gut, vet zain gut'. The incoming letters and panim are not present on the public page, so the initiating situation remains only partially recoverable.
